ui.footer: Factorio Save Backup Manager - Rust + Slint 1.17
ui.authorize-wait: Authorizing with Google: the browser will open. Wait for the confirmation in the log.
ui.gd-no-creds-body:
To upload or download backups you need Google Drive credentials:
1. Open Google Cloud Console and create (or pick) a project.
2. Enable the "Google Drive API" for that project.
3. Create an "OAuth 2.0 Client ID" of type "Desktop app".
4. Download it as credentials.json and place it next to the app
   (or set its path in the field above).
5. Click "Authorize Google Drive" and complete the login.
ui.gd-creds-body:
The credentials file was not found at the configured path.
Check the path above, or download an "OAuth 2.0 Client ID"
(Desktop app) from Google Cloud Console and place it
next to the app as credentials.json.
ui.gd-ready-body:
Credentials found. If you already authorized the app, uploads and
downloads will work. Otherwise click "Authorize Google Drive".
ui.tip-copy: Copy the last backup link to the clipboard
ui.tip-force-check: Check the saves folder for changes and upload a backup if something changed
ui.tip-manual-upload: Choose a local save and upload it to the cloud right now
ui.tip-sync-cloud: If the cloud has a newer save than the local one, download it (making a local backup first)
ui.tip-download-drive: Pick a backup stored on Google Drive and download it to the saves folder
ui.tip-download-discord: Download the most recent backup posted on the configured Discord channel
ui.tip-test-save: Create a dummy .zip save in the saves folder to test the monitoring without playing
ui.tip-settings: Open the settings: language, backup prefix, Discord and Google Drive
ui.tip-next-check: Time until the next automatic backup check. It resets after every upload or manual check
ui.tip-interval: How often the saves folder is checked for changes (minutes)
ui.tip-prefix: Text prepended to uploaded backups, e.g. MegaBase_my-save_20260909_120000.zip
ui.tip-language: Interface and log language. English by default. Press Save to make it permanent
ui.tip-obfuscate: Hide webhook and tokens in config.json (simple obfuscation, not encryption)
ui.tip-webhook: Discord webhook URL used to announce new backups. Get it in: Server Settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks
ui.tip-channel: Numeric ID of the Discord channel where the bot looks for backups (right click on the channel -> Copy Channel ID)
ui.tip-bot: Discord bot token, only needed for Download Discord. Enabled with Developer Mode + Message Content Intent
ui.tip-creds: Path to the Google OAuth credentials.json (Desktop app type). Leave empty for ./credentials.json next to the app
ui.tip-folder: Google Drive folder ID where backups are stored. Empty = your Drive root
ui.tip-authorize: Opens the browser to authorize Google Drive access (required once before uploading/downloading)
ui.tip-save: Apply and persist all settings to config.json
ui.tip-cancel: Close without saving changes. Reverts any language preview
